normalization: Only actual doc_id fields bound by each inspected request; JSON text decoded. No fields discarded.

limitations: sampled peaks can miss short-lived children or between-sample peaks
RSS sums include shared pages; footprint is also summed, not unique pages
startup includes Popen, sampler setup and real initialize roundtrip
request roundtrip includes client JSON, pipes and scheduling
CPU converted from Mach ticks with mach_timebase_info; raw *_ticks retained
start/exit/child elapsed identities are raw Mach ticks
root child CPU counters cover reaped children and may lag
boundary descendant CPU covers children still live; excludes already exited children
physical disk counters can be zero for cached IO; not logical filesystem IO
diagnostic wrapper runs measure actual vendor CLI wall and child CPU separately
diagnostic wrapper bootstrap adds overhead; do not use as direct speed comparison
outside-CLI remainder contains server, IPC, filesystem and wrapper bootstrap
server CPU, physical IO and ping are observations, not exclusive wall phases
engine_mode recorded explicitly, live disabled; no GUI operations measured
